messages:
lena: FYI customer hit "Cannot find module 'redwood-sdk'" when using require() in an older Electron app.
omar: probably our export map change removed the plain CJS entry. which sdk version?
lena: v6.2.1. package uses conditional exports only, no top-level main or explicit require condition.
omar: quick workaround: restore a top-level "main" pointing at dist/cjs/index.cjs and add a "require" condition in exports. Also set "types" to dist/types/index.d.ts so TS finds defs.
lena: can we add a tiny smoke test: `node -e "require('redwood-sdk')"` on node14/electron11 in CI matrix?
ombot: CI: sample-suite electron11/node14 failed - exit 1.
omar: opening patch to add main/require/types and a node14 smoke test. will add changelog note about export map compat.
lena: thanks — I'll reply to the customer with the workaround (install sdk@6.1.x) and link the PR once ready.
build-bot: PR pipeline started: redwood/sdk#449-add-cjs-require-fallback
lena: closing loop for now.
